hypotheses.justification: hinf follows from hKG. By definition closedJordanCore H = (⋃ i, (↑) '' jordanInterior (H i))ᶜ, and every point of that union is of the form (↑)z, which is never OnePoint.infty (OnePoint.coe_ne_infty). So OnePoint.infty ∈ closedJordanCore H, and hKG gives OnePoint.infty ∈ G. This also holds when I is empty, because then the core is univ. The theorem therefore stays true after deleting hinf. The proof changes by one line: define hinf' : OnePoint.infty ∈ G := hKG (fun h => by obtain ⟨i, z, _, hz⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp h; exact OnePoint.coe_ne_infty z hz). Then pass hinf' to open_image_jordan_side_subset, which is where the hypothesis was used. Nothing else in the statement depends on hinf.
